title_en: Apartment 2+1+2 for sale - Behind the Red School!

Data on the apartment: Floor: 7 living Living area: 85.15 m² Common area: 11.66 m² Total area: 96.81 m² Construction phase: Cubic area -2 Price: 2,500 € / m² Payment method: 50% of the value with the signing of the contract The remaining part to be paid until May 2026 The apartment offers functional organization, well-used spaces and located in a consolidated area, ideal for both family living and investment.
